messages:
olivia-pd: FYI Support flagged three separate asks from customers about tenant-level routing tags. They look like the same underlying request (route by customer tag + UI to manage). Can we cluster and pick a canonical backlog item?
raj-eng: Seen. Can you paste the 3 ticket links? want to check if they differ in scope (routing vs UI vs audit logs). :mag:
alex-support: Ticket links: https://zendesk/10021, https://zendesk/10045, https://zendesk/10087. Short notes: #10021 wants tag-based routing controls, #10045 asks for UI to set tags per-tenant, #10087 is asking telemetry on tag usage.
mike-prod: My take: single epic "tenant-routing+management" with sub-tasks: routing policy, admin UI, usage telemetry. That keeps customers linked but avoids duplicates. Recommend canonicalize to PRO-5892.
emma-sre: Agree with epic. Operational note: routing policy may have infra implications (stateful cache changes). Estimate: infra work ~2 sprints if prioritized.
olivia-pd: Good context. @raj-eng can you own creating the canonical ticket and tagging the three zendesk items as duplicates? We'll set initial priority as P2 until we validate active customers.
raj-eng: I can own. Will create PRO-5892 and add tag "canonical-customer-ask". Also will post a short comms back to each requester asking for priority & use-case.
support-bot: Automated note: Ticket 10021 linked to product PRO-5892 as duplicate.
alex-support: When we message customers, can we use a short opt-in template? Something like:
```
Hi <Customer>,
Thanks for the ask — we consolidated similar requests into a single product item (PRO-5892). Could you confirm the priority for your team and any concrete examples of routing rules you need? This will help prioritize the work.
Thanks, Alex (Support)
```
:memo:
raj-eng: copying that template into the zendesk replies. Also adding label: "incoming-customer-signal" and "dup-linked".
mike-prod: Decision: link + keep open until we have 2+ customers confirming priority OR a paying-customer escalation. If neither in 3 weeks, we'll move to backlog/icebox and notify requesters.
emma-sre: FYI, if we escalate, we should surface an infra spike first to scope cache changes. I'll prep a 3-day spike doc.
olivia-pd: Sounds good. Next steps: (1) @raj-eng create PRO-5892 and link tickets (done by EOD) (2) @alex-support send template replies (tomorrow) (3) @emma-sre draft infra spike if customers push for priority (within 3 business days). I'll add a note in roadmap board under "Customer Signals". :white_check_mark:
raj-eng: Done — PRO-5892 created https://redwood.atlassian/browse/PRO-5892. Linked tickets and added tags.
alex-support: Replies sent to all three requesters, asked for priority & examples.
support-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up check in 3 weeks for PRO-5892 status.
mike-prod: Thanks everyone. I'll slot PRO-5892 on next grooming agenda so we can review any incoming customer confirmations and pick scope for an MVP. :eyes:
olivia-pd: Closing thread here; will update the roadmap card after grooming.
